mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, SUM(cost) AS cost, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM t_token_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H') AS bucket, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, SUM(cost) AS cost, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM t_token_usage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
